en: A black‑and‑white/sepia photograph showing a corner view of a large wooden hotel building with a central turret and many windows, labeled as the hotel in Lilla Edet. The street in front is quiet, bordered by wooden fences and additional timber houses. In the background are trees, scattered houses, and low, forested hills under a cloudy sky. The image has the typical framing and caption style of an early 20th‑century postcard.
